prompt: We're a Norwegian defense contractor with a BEGRENSET (restricted) private cloud on-prem running Kubernetes. We need to use some AWS services (S3 for large file storage, SageMaker for ML training on non-classified data) but our on-prem network handles BEGRENSET data that must stay in Norway. We have a Direct Connect link to AWS eu-north-1 (Stockholm). How do we architect the hybrid network so that AWS services can communicate with our on-prem APIs without exposing BEGRENSET data to AWS? We need to comply with Sikkerhetsloven and NSM guidelines. Also design the monitoring so we can see traffic flows across both environments.

assertions.name: sensitivity_boundary_design
assertions.description: Designs a clear boundary between BEGRENSET on-prem and cloud, with data classification controls

assertions.name: data_stays_onprem
assertions.description: Ensures BEGRENSET data stays on-prem, only non-classified data reaches AWS

assertions.name: approved_vpn_encryption
assertions.description: Addresses encryption on the Direct Connect link (IPsec VPN overlay or NSM-approved encryption)

assertions.name: exchange_zone
assertions.description: Creates an exchange/gateway zone between on-prem sensitive and cloud-connected networks

assertions.name: api_gateway_boundary
assertions.description: Uses API gateway or reverse proxy at the boundary to control what data crosses

assertions.name: aws_service_specifics
assertions.description: Addresses S3 and SageMaker integration specifically (VPC endpoints, IAM roles, encryption)

assertions.name: sikkerhetsloven_compliance
assertions.description: References Sikkerhetsloven and NSM requirements for the hybrid architecture

assertions.name: unified_monitoring
assertions.description: Designs monitoring spanning both environments (Prometheus, CloudWatch, unified dashboards)

assertions.name: traffic_flow_visibility
assertions.description: Provides visibility into cross-boundary traffic (flow logs, network monitoring, anomaly detection)

assertions.name: incident_isolation
assertions.description: Ability to isolate cloud from on-prem quickly in case of incident

assertions.name: eu_north_data_residency
assertions.description: Addresses that eu-north-1 is in Stockholm (Sweden, not Norway) and implications for Norwegian data sovereignty

assertions.name: nsm_grunnprinsipper_applied
assertions.description: Applies NSM Grunnprinsipper categories (identify, protect, detect, respond) to the hybrid architecture
